title: Name the original-parent recovery when the data branch moves at the export's post-admission file fence
outcome: Name the original-parent recovery when the data branch moves at the export's post-admission file fence
acceptance: When another Git operation advances the data branch after the export admitted its new head and before the file fence (task-only and combined cleanup boundary), the refusal names the original-parent recovery with the observed tip, never a generic import that then refuses; a deterministic test advances the branch in that window and the named remedy then succeeds
